old_reading: Lia gets to the library at nine.
The reading room opens at ten.
There is a bench next to the door.
Lia sits there and reads a book.
At ten, she finds a quiet seat inside.
old_dialogue: Is the library open?
Not yet. It opens at ten.
Is there a place to wait?
Yes. There is a bench outside.
Where is the reading room?
It is on the first floor.
Is there a quiet seat there?
Yes. There is a seat by the window.

Sure. See you there on Saturday.

Can we sit by the pond?

Of course. Move it a little closer.

You can put it under the table.

Rosa writes her name on the line.
She also writes a short name for her name tag.
Then she puts the paper on the desk.
old_dialogue: Where do I write my name?
Write your name at the top of the page, please.
Do I write my last name too?
Yes. Write both names, please.
What goes on the name tag?
Use only your first name.
Where do I put the paper?
Put it on my desk, please.

No. Do not run on the wet bridge.
Can we leave the trail here?
No. Stay on the path.
What does that sign say?
It says, do not climb the fence.
Can we stop after the bridge?
Yes. Wait by the next sign.
